summary: YXT.COM GROUP HOLDING LIMITED filed a prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for an offering of 150,000 ADSs at $7.00 per ADS, with each ADS representing 30 Class A ordinary shares. The ADSs trade on Nasdaq under 'YXT'; last sale on August 5, 2026 was $23.43 per ADS, implying a 70% discount to market. Univest Securities LLC acts as placement agent on a best-efforts basis, receiving a 7% cash fee, with no minimum offering requirement. Proceeds are estimated at $976,500 before expenses. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
